## What this PR adds

- [ ] Directory entry (new or corrected) in `data/directory.yaml`
- [ ] Game write-up in `games/<game>/`
- [ ] Playbook change in `playbook/`

## Evidence

Sources for every claim (links), and for game write-ups the QA level reached:

- QA level: none / community-reports / automated / verified-playthrough
- How it was tested (harness, number of clients, what was asserted):

## Checklist

- [ ] `python tools/build_directory.py` was run and DIRECTORY.md is regenerated
- [ ] No personal info (real names, emails, local paths with usernames, tokens, invite links to private servers)
- [ ] Nothing copyrighted from the game itself (no game files, no decompiled source of closed games)
- [ ] If an agent wrote this: the owner reviewed it before submitting
